note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). NT verses are pasted from the ebible mirror (amh_amh); the mirror has no OT, so OT quotations are self_rendered in the 1962 register unless a shipped Amharic work already quotes the verse (source_file names it).

Rows come from the translators' reports and every 'mined' claim was re-verified: each quoted fragment must be a byte-exact substring both of this body and of the NT file (or of the cited shipped work); a claim that fails is recorded as self_rendered. Some mirror entries are merged verse ranges holding only part of the text, so verses inside them are self_rendered.
